**🐛 DEBUGGING CORNER**

**Problem**: React useEffect running twice

**Cause**: React 18 Strict Mode in development

**Solution**: This is intentional! It helps find bugs.

```typescript
// Wrong - will run twice in dev
useEffect(() => {
  fetchData(); // Called twice
}, []);

// Right - with cleanup
useEffect(() => {
  let cancelled = false;
  fetchData().then(data => {
    if (!cancelled) setData(data);
  });
  return () => { cancelled = true; };
}, []);
```
